programme.desc: Cartman har en ny Trapper Keeper. Efter att han slutat skryta om den berättar en främling att den snart kommer att ta över världen såvida de inte förstör den nu.

programme.title: South Park: Det galna antastningsäventyret
programme.desc: Kyle ringer polisen för att rapportera att hans föräldrar antastar honom. Snart anger alla barnen sina föräldrar, tills det bara finns barn kvar i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: När det träffar fläkten
programme.desc: Det blir uppror i South Park när invånarna hör ordet '****' i det populära programmet 'Cop Drama'.

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Stan skaffar en Okama Gamesphere och pojkarna fascineras av den. Medan de spelar kommer en pratande handduk som heter Towelie och pratar med dem.

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos
programme.desc: Killarna avskedar Butters från att vara deras vän, vilket framkallar hans mörka sida.

programme.title: South Park: Kidnappning är inte kul
programme.desc: Efter att ha tittat på för mycket TV är Tweek övertygad om att barn lever farligt och att han kommer att bli kidnappad.

programme.title: South Park: Grå gryning
programme.desc: Pensionärer tvingas lämna in sina körkort efter att de orsakat kaos på gatorna. Stans farfar anlitar AARP för att hjälpa pensionärerna att få dem tillbaka.

programme.title: South Park: Geggfolk
programme.desc: South Park översvämmas av arbetare från framtiden som tar alla jobben för lägre löner. Männen i South Park går förvånansvärt långt för att stoppa dem.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: När Wall-Mart omvandlar South Park till en spökstad försöker Stan och Kyle förstöra affären, men en besatt Cartman ställer sig i vägen.

programme.title: South Park: Bästisar för alltid
programme.desc: Cartman blir avundsjuk när Kenny får den sista spelkonsolen innan den är slut på affären. Kommer Cartman och Kenny att kunna fortsätta vara bästa vänner för all framtid?

programme.title: South Park: Passa er för de självgoda!
programme.desc: South Parks invånare köper hybridbilar. Men precis när det börjar känna sig riktigt nöjda med sin miljövänlighet samlas ett mörkt moln över staden.

programme.title: South Park: Kärlek, inte Warcraft
programme.desc: Pojkarna har spelat datorspelet World of Warcraft hela helgen när en skurkaktig spelare dödar dem utan samvetskval.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med tvåan i pissoaren
programme.desc: Cartman tror att han vet vem som var hjärnan bakom 9/11.

programme.title: South Park: Heja Gud
programme.desc: Cartman försöker resa till framtiden för att köpa ett nytt datorspel.

programme.title: South Park: Heja Gud XII
programme.desc: Cartman fryser sig själv och vaknar upp 500 år senare.

programme.title: South Park: Lössningen
programme.desc: Cartman tar sig an uppgiften att ta reda på från vem alla lössen i South Park Elementary kommer ifrån så att han kan reta honom.

programme.title: South Park: De levande hemlösas natt
programme.desc: När South Park översvämmas av hemlösa människor tänker pojkarna ut en listig plan för att flytta dem till en annan stad medan de vuxna får panik.

programme.title: South Park: Tutt-tankar
programme.desc: South Parks hysteriska föräldrar har ytterligare en anledning att få panik efter att 'cheesing' blir populärt bland barnen.

programme.title: South Park: Utloggad
programme.desc: Förvirring och panik råder då South Park upptäcker att de inte har internet!

programme.title: South Park: Pandemin
programme.desc: South Park börjar likna Cloverfield när Randy visar dem skakiga inspelningar han gjort med sin videokamera av en stor mystisk varelse som härjar jorden runt.

programme.title: En himla många program Box, Hela serien. Dubbel Dubbel
programme.desc: En himla många program Alla 9 TV-programmen digitalt renoverade

programme.title: Söderkåkar
programme.desc: Buskis baserad på Gideon Wahlbergs älskade klassiker. En förveklingsfars med hembiträden, grosshandlare, stiliga poliskonstaplar, kärleksproblem, brännvin och en förvirrad brevbärare vid namn Dag-Otto.

programme.title: Macken Scenföreställningen
programme.desc: Av TV-serien Macken från 1986 gjordes 2016 en scenversion, som sattes upp på Lorensbergsteatern i Göteborg för att fira teaterns hundraårsjubileum.

programme.title: Två Bröder Emellan
programme.desc: Bröderna Gustav och Ingmar driver en diversehandel. Här säljer de allt från drivmedel, fisknät, musikinstrument, däck och dessutom serverar man mat och dryck inte en helt lysande affär! Men varför vill kommunen helt plötsligt köpa?

programme.title: Två Ägg i högklackat
programme.desc: Ett år har gått sedan vi hälsade på bröderna Nilsson senast. Lillebror Ingemar har storsatsat på konferens och underhållning medan storebror Gustav reparerar motorsågar

programme.title: Bröllop i Kikar´n
programme.desc: Våge och Florence har bestämt sig för att öppna ett Pensionat och de första gästerna är på väg. De är Tage och Harriet, ett par som ska gifta sig. Frågan är nu om Harriet hade tänkt att dom skulle bo just här

programme.title: Solsting och Snedsprång
programme.desc: Året är 1961. Sågverksarbetaren Reuben söker lyckan genom att köpa ett hotell på soliga Mallorca för familjens semesterkassa. Men saker och ting blir inte som han tänkt sig.

programme.title: Bröllop & Jäkelskap
programme.desc: Det har gått ett år sedan Nils-Erik försökte lura sin familj och omgivning genom att iscensätta sin egen död. Hans fru Matilda genomskådade dock bluffen. Nu rustas det för bröllop. Parets tafatte son Lennart behöver bara lite hjälp på traven.

programme.title: Stinsen Brinner (Scenföreställningen)
programme.desc: Det här är en föreställning som heter Stinsen brinner och det är den första föreställningen som spelades på Lorensbergsteatern i Göteborg sedan teatern åter blivit teater efter att ha varit bio i 54 år.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Jade City-teamet förföljs av stor otur och alla kommer på unika lösningar för att försöka jaga bort demonerna.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alla blir upprymda när de äntligen börjar gräva upp utlovande gröna stenblock som besättningen tror är värda miljoner.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spänningarna kokar över när de utländska investerarna oväntat kommer förbi för att inspektera arbetet på gruvplatsen Wolverine och Alan försöker skipa fred.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: När de äntligen hittar några lovande stenblock vid Wolverinegruvan, upptäcker teamet att de kan ha brutit mot gruvdriftsreglerna.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spänningen stiger när slutet av gruvsäsongen närmar sig och teamet i Jade City blir angelägna om att hitta det gäckande stenblocket värt miljontals dollar.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Minusgrader utmanar gruvarbetarna i Jade City som har bråttom för att hitta jackpotten – en jadesten som är tillräckligt stor för att imponera på investerarna – innan säsongen är slut.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia och Robins oprövade maskiner börjar gå sönder på den brutala färden upp till Wolverine-gruvan.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet försöker korsa forsande floder under sin marsch med sina maskiner upp till gruvan, men Josh hamnar på efterkälken i sin problembenägna grävmaskin.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Josh blir strandsatt på den långa leden till Wolverine-gruvan när bultar skakas loss från hans grävmaskin, och han kan inte ringa efter hjälp.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Gruvsäsongen börjar och medan jaden visar sig svårhittad, förvandlas en lastbilsolycka till en lönsam händelse för Jade City.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Guy blir ansvarig för Wolverine, där upplärningen av en ny arbetare hotar att stå i vägen för hans uppdrag att hitta säsongens första jade.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Precis när teamet på Wolverine skärper sina säkerhetsrutiner kollapsar den nya arbetaren Jay, vilket exponerar sprickorna i deras nödberedskap.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Josh blir strandsatt i den nya grävmaskinen samtidigt som ett lager av värdelösa stenar gör att Claudia börjar överväga en ny gruvstrategi.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alan tar med sig en grupp köpare till Jade City vilket skapar panikläge i Claudias team för att hitta säsongens första säljbara jadeblock.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Medan besättningen kämpar sig genom lera för att hitta ett stenblock som är värt en miljon dollar, riskerar Josh att förlora utrustning för halv miljon dollar när han försöker dra upp sin lastbil ur ett slukhål.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet hittar säsongens bästa jadeblock, men riskerar att minska dess värde när de försöker kapa bort alla frakturer.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias son Justin visar att han har en näsa för jade, medan Scrappy Larry, Robin och Josh kämpar för att bogsera sin trasiga lastbil upp från spåret till Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: En körning av tillhörigheter tvingar ut Robin och Justin på ett sista försök att leta efter jadestenar för att rädda säsongen medan Scrappy Larry har bråttom för att få en dieseltank ombyggd.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias satsning på att driva en arbetsgrupp i Jade City hotas när septiktanken backar in i deras dricksvatten.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Med tidig ankomst av det kalla vädret och med skulder som hopar sig, knuffar, släpar och skjuter besättningen på en maffig och potentiellt säsongsvinnande sten till lägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Med årets mest lovande stenblock under sågen på Wolverine, kör Josh och R2 i diket med sin lastbil, vilket även drabbar Claudia och teamet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Loppet pågår för att ta sig bort från Wolverine-lägret innan snön täcker allt.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia blir tvungen att köra stenbilen när hennes besättning kämpar sig uppför den steniga stigen till deras bergstoppsbelägna jadeläger, Wolverine

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spänningarna kulminerar när Claudia, Robin och teamet försöker transportera människor och utrustning till det avlägsna jadelägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia och Robin försöker imponera på sina nya affärspartners men de första dagarna på deras nya område, Bullion Creek, är krävande.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Säsongens första stora stenblock transporteras tillbaka till lägret och sätts under sågen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin skyndar sig för att inmuta ett område efter att han snubblat över ett fantastiskt jadefynd, men andra gruvarbetare närmar sig.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias nya partnerskap blir lidande när Justin och teamet distraheras av att försöka flytta ett gigantiskt stenblock som kan vara värt en förmögenhet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Efter att ha hamnat i konflikt med sina affärspartners, tävlar Claudia och Robin om att starta om gruvdriften vid Wolverine, men blir stoppade av ett överraskande hinder.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet kämpar för att få igång Dynastys jadebrott trots bristfällig utrustning.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin och Mike kämpar med frakturer och varandra och försöker bevisa sina metoder för otåliga investerare.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alan återvänder från Kina och ger Justin och Mike en kalldusch av verklighet angående jaden som de håller på att bryta.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin och Mike kämpar sig genom snö och fruset vatten för att ta sig fram till det enda potentiellt väldigt värdefulla klippblocket med jade – Big Fin.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Vintern anländer till Dynasty och teamet kämpar med gruvbrytningen fram till allra sista minuten.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia finansierar själv sin stenbrottssäsong och bestämmer sig för att börja jakten på jade en månad tidigare och tvingas ompröva sin strategi när snö och högt vatten stoppar teamet i dess spår.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Robin följer sin intuition till en ny sida på ett gammalt bergsbruksområde, medan Joshs höga förväntningar och korta stubin frestar på Garys tålamod.

programme.title: Matlock: The Witness Killings (Part 1)
programme.desc: When Matlock returns to his hometown, he ends up defending an accused murderer and becoming the town’s worst enemy.

programme.title: Matlock: The Witness Killings (Part 2)
programme.desc: When Matlock returns to his hometown, he ends up defending an accused murderer and becoming the town’s worst enemy.

programme.title: Matlock: The Strangler
programme.desc: Matlock’s personal accountant seeks representation by Ben when he is framed for the brutal murder of his employer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Nightmare
programme.desc: A vacation to a wild west ghost town becomes more than Matlock bargained for as a bump on the head takes him straight back in time to the real old wild west, surrounded by familiar faces – with very unfamiliar occupations.

programme.title: Matlock: The Marriage Counselor
programme.desc: Matlock’s dull, droning insurance broker, Allan Corning finds therapy for his struggling marriage interrupted by the sudden murder of his therapist, Dr. Harding Fletcher.

programme.title: Matlock: The Dame
programme.desc: When Matlock is slapped by an attractive older woman in a restaurant, Ben recalls to Julie the story of his first case – the murder of the man who put him through law school.

programme.title: Matlock: The Suspect (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Suspect (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Defense
programme.desc: After witnessing a violent argument between his parents, a distraught young man murders his abusive father.

programme.title: Matlock: The Game Show
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the defense of popular game show host Dennis Blake who’s accused of the murder of his successful, yet despised mega-millionaire producer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Foursome
programme.desc: A brash multimillionaire, Ellis Blake is held in the slaying of Jeffrey Holden, a handsome, young man who intended to marry Ellis’ daughter – without his blessing or consent.

programme.title: Matlock: The Picture (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock’s search for evidence to prove his client innocent of killing her husband uncovers a ring of counterfeiters who will pay any price, including murder, to keep their secret. Ben’s investigation uncovers ties to the mob.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock’s faith in his ability as a top-notch attorney is completely eroded when he’s dismissed by a client and replaced by a younger lawyer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 2)
programme.desc: During his fishing trip, Matlock encounters the small, unfriendly town of Lone Pine as he attempts to solve the mysterious death of a young farmhand and uncover a town-wide coverup.

programme.title: Matlock: The Abduction
programme.desc: While attending a UCLA Law seminar, Matlock and Michelle end up in a dangerous dilemma. After giving Matlock inside information regarding an upcoming hit his former law school classmate is involved in a fatal hit and run.

programme.title: Matlock: Mr. Awesome
programme.desc: Matlock defends Anne Johnson, a single mother who’s been accused of murdering her recently estranged boyfriend.

programme.title: Matlock: The Evening News (Part 1)
programme.desc: A phony story is planted on the nightly news when a corrupt land developer pays off the on-air talent but when the producer fakes his own death, the anchorwoman unwittingly helps him along, never realizing it’s somebody else she killed.

programme.desc: Caroline has difficulty confronting her neglectful building superintendent, Mr. Tedescu about her faulty plumbing, so she hires a mediator to pressure Mr. Tedescu into taking care of her request.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Richard is stunned when his former love Julia informs him that she is about to be married.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: In the ongoing charade of Caroline pretending that she and Richard are married.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: A remorseful Caroline panics when she realizes that several hours have passed since she poured her heart out to Richard on his answering machine -- and she hasn't heard a response from him.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline realizes that the constant aching in her neck could be related to the stress she feels over her unresolved feelings toward Richard, but she doesn't let it get in the way of helping Richard navigate through troubled waters with Julia.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline feigns having read a writer’s novel to impress him, but their first date is a disaster as Caroline’s charade crumbles. Meanwhile, Richard jumps to Julia’s rescue when her waitress job at Remo’s leaves her customers hungry for attention.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline discovers that she’s been receiving free cable, her honesty with the cable company gets her into deep trouble with her not-so-truthful neighbors.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Annie is visited by her old singing teacher, Miss McGowan, Caroline helps Annie pretend to still have her “Cats” role, an act that may have a surprise ending.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: It’s a game of messy politics when Caroline will not endorse a local councilman, who is inspired by her comic strip, while Del conjures up a promotional campaign.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Discreetly planning to ease Caroline’s homesick holiday blues, Richard (Malcolm Gets) goes to great lengths to get a gift for Caroline that inspires suspicion in Julia (Sofia Milos) and sleuthing from Caroline and Annie.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Used Car Salesman

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Informed by Annie (Amy Pietz) of Caroline’s (LeaThompson) unspoken love for him, Richard (Malcolm Gets) confronts Caroline, who tells him that it’s a thing of the past.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Love That Dare Not Speak Its Name

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is tapped as a celebrity guest star for a quiz show, her jitters prompt Richard (Malcolm Gets) to help her study, much to Julia’s (Sofia Milos) chagrin.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) tries to convince an insecure Del(Eric Lutes) that he has the potential to be a great parent after Del is shocked to discover that he is the father of a 10-year old girl.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Julia (Sofia Milos) tells Caroline (Lea Thompson) that it’s not easy being on the outside of her close working relationship with Richard (Malcolm Gets), Caroline quickly, and mysteriously, learns what it’s like to walk a mile in Julia’s shoes.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: As Caroline (Lea Thompson) struggles with commitment issues over Trevor, Richard(Malcolm Gets) inadvertently causes a rift between Caroline and her new beau.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is insulted by a local cabbie, Adamo, she takes her case to higher powers at the travel commission. Meanwhile, Richard, frustrated by a “painter’s block,” becomes obsessed with computers when he joins a cyber cafe.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline’s (Lea Thompson)mother, Margaret Duffy (guest star Edie McClurg, “The Hogan Family”), visits Caroline for a mother-daughter People magazine shoot, tensions rise over unexpressed feelings.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Visit From The Mom

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) must hire a new cartoon colorist when Richard (Malcolm Gets) finally quits after he and Julia (Sofia Milos) move into their glamorous new home.
programme.sub-title: Caroline and the Marriage Counselor, Pt. 1

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: The fourth-season opener finds Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) savoring their first passionate kiss and preparing for romance.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Guys In The Bathroom

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Vengeful father-in-law Mr. Mazzone strips Richard (Malcolm Gets) of all his worldly possessions, forcing Richard to take temporary refuge in Caroline's (Lea Thompson) new office, where he runs afoul of Plum, the no-nonsense office manager.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: After Caroline (Lea Thompson) inadvertently offends office manager Plum (guest star Nancy Lenehan, "Grace Under Fire"), she and Richard (Malcolm Gets) are banished to a damp, dark basement office.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: After Annie (Amy Pietz) loses her boyfriend, her job and her agent, she impulsively accepts a date with her local drycleaner, Gil (guest star Ken Campbell),and spends an evening to remember.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) decide to go out on their first official "date" together on Halloween, but their romantic evening turns into fright night when Richard gets himself into a rooftop jam.

programme.desc: Reverend Jim comes to the rescue when Alex is consumed by gambling fever after a lucky night in Atlantic City.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.desc: After Latka has an affair with a female cabbie, Simka must do the same with one of his co-workers.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Jeff ends up in serious trouble after he confesses to stealing from the garage to protect the real villain.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex dreams of a new career in show business when he takes a part-time job as an assistant to a Broadway producer.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Hilarious complications unfold when Louie starts dating the mercurial Emily after vowing never to see her again.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When Louie learns that his old girlfriend, Zena, is getting married, he boycotts the wedding and decides to barge in on her honeymoon.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex tries to polish the diamond-in-the-rough, Louie, into a real gem—while Louie decides to change his image by moving into a fancy apartment building.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex starts driving all the other cabbies crazy when he discovers his beloved family pet only has a short time to live.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Elaine becomes a nervous wreck when her young son decides to give up the oboe and take up boxing under the tutelage of Tony.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When Jim's old girlfriend shows up hoping to rekindle their romance, Alex quickly sets out to win her heart away from her former suitor.
programme.sub-title: Alex Gets Burned By An Old Flame

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: On the eve of the biggest fight of his career, Tony loses interest in boxing when his girlfriend announces she may be expecting his baby.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie is worried his blind girlfriend will no longer love him if an operation to restore her sight is successful.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: To what lengths will boyfriend Arnie go to win over Elaine's kids? Elaine is in for a surprise when she invites him over to meet her children.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies come to the rescue when Jim tries to convince his family that he didn't squander his inheritance by buying a run-down restaurant.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Latka worries that Simka's wacky behavior might cost her the right to remain permanently in America.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies embark on a frantic race against time when they team up in a wild nonstop drive from New York to Miami so that Alex can see his long-lost daughter on her twenty-minute layover at the airport in the premiere episode of Taxi.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex’s romantic instincts are triggered by the sexy voice at the answering service. Her alluring manner prompts him to arrange a dinner date that turns into a big surprise on Taxi.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: A pretty girl has John in a whirl, and his determination to meet her prompts the taxi gang to come up with a surefire line that would unfreeze any woman on earth in Taxi.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.desc: Mechanic Latka Gravas faces deportation unless he marries a U.S. citizen. The taxi gang comes to his rescue by pitching in and hiring a local working girl to be his bride.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: John and his new wife, Suzanne, reach a crisis point in their marriage when one of them must drop out of college due to financial woes.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The taxi gang scrambles to come up with a scheme aimed at ending a one-sided romance when a determined, pretty cabbie sets her cap for Tony and joins the Sunshine Cab Co. to be near him.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex feels sympathy for a fare who’s a real loser with the women and arranges a date for the man with Elaine, who later discovers that her klutzy companion for the evening is a U.S. Congressman.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby’s career dreams come true when he lands a role in a soap opera, prompting him to throw his torn-up cabbie’s license at Louie, but the dispatcher vows to take revenge if Bobby ever comes crawling back.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: After an operation, Louie, the sharp-tongued dispatcher, panics when he has to keep a promise that he made to God during surgery to turn over a new leaf.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Mechanic Latka Gravas’ youthful and attractive mother makes her first visit to America, and after she and Alex meet and have an evening love affair, Latka assumes that he will soon be getting a new daddy.

programme.desc: The cabbies fall victim to a Hollywood-style roller coaster ride when a production company visits to do a film on taxi drivers. Life at the Sunshine Cab Company turns into a continual champagne and buffet festivity.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When John crashes Cab 804, the cabbies are shocked into a period of mourning, as they reminisce about the wild and memorable events that occurred when they were driving the legendary cab.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.
programme.sub-title: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: Mata Hari. Dance, Seduction and Espionage. The enduring myth.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Today’s infantry demands a weapon combining machine gun firepower with rifle accuracy and mobility.. Host Wil Willis traces this journey through iconic firearms.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Secret War: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.desc: Monty Woodhouse, a professor and a legend for blowing up the Gorgopotamos Bridge in Greece in 1942. In the British counter attack against Rommell at Al Alamein in North Africa it was vital to disrupt German supply routes, Greece.
programme.sub-title: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 6
programme.desc: The final ten sample the flamboyant world of high fashion in a catwalk show with unusual accessories, before bearing all for a nude shoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7
programme.desc: The contestants demonstrate their acting skills in milk commercials before taking part in a photoshoot inspired by classic children's stories.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 8
programme.desc: Journalist Hilary Alexander quizzes the would-be catwalk stars on the industry they are so eager to become part of. The winners are treated to a party with former contestants including last year's winner Letitia Herod.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson enrols the seven remaining contestants in a Fashion Targets Breast Cancer catwalk event for their biggest showcase yet and they also take part in a beauty shoot with a cosmetics company.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: The six remaining girls arrive in Barbados and hit the waves for a surfing-themed tourism advert. The action remains on the water for a boat-based photoshoot with Dannii Minogue and a leading hair-care brand, ahead of the dreaded elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The final five star in a music video with Bajan pop group Cover Drive and have to learn a complicated dance routine, before Elle Macpherson challenges the contestants to model jewellery in a photoshoot set in a limestone cavern.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: The four remaining girls compete for a place in next week's final, demonstrating what they have learnt by styling themselves for a Bajan magazine cover shoot. After that, Tyson Beckford sets the contestants a challenge at a sugar plantation.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: The three remaining contestants take part in their final photoshoot a Caribbean carnival-themed catwalk show infront of an audience of industry bigwigs. Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford and Dannii Minogue then select the winner.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Robin slösar bort alla sina pengar på dyra hobbies. Han har precis gjort slut med Madeleine från förra avsnittet, och med hennes skyhöga skulder och överdrivna utgifter är hans nya liv svårt.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Bibbi är sjuksköterska och ska snart gå i pension, men med sina skulder kommer hon inte att kunna gå i pension vid 67 års ålder. Hennes hus är fullt av kläder, smycken och tomma champagneflaskor. Kommer hon att kunna ändra sin livsstil?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Roy Erik köper och säljer klockor varannan vecka och experterna har aldrig sett ett sådant slöseri. Han köper på impuls och säljer med förlust. Med sin höga skuld kommer han aldrig att kunna köpa ett eget hus.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Helene har en bra inkomst, men i stället för att lägga undan pengar shoppar hon. Hon lägger 13.000 norska kronor i månaden bara på nätshopping och drömmen om att köpa ett eget hus känns avlägsen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Arild blandar ihop sin privatekonomi med sitt företag och har därför tappat kontrollen. Han har skulder på långt över en miljon kronor. Arild är en skicklig tatuerare, men hur kan han rädda sin ekonomi?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Hilde slösar bort sin lön som lastbilschaufför på sitt bilintresse. Hon struntar i räkningarna, kylskåpet är tomt, elen är på väg att stängas av och skulderna växer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Ellinor har sålt sitt hus och är på väg att starta om sitt liv. Trots en bra inkomst har hon det kämpigt. Experterna följer med henne under flyttprocessen och blir chockade över hur mycket pengar som läggs på onödiga inköp.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501
programme.desc: Ørjan har köpt och sålt över 100 bilar under 13 års tid och hans tomt är full av olika fordon. Han har en bra lön, men spenderar desto mer, och när kontot ekar tomt handlas det på kredit.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: Else har skatteskulder och riskerar att bli av med sitt hus. De höga elpriserna och Elses överdrivna konsumtion av kaffe, mat och mobilspel tar över hennes budget och får framtiden att se mörk ut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Odins liv vändes på sin kant när han sjuk i cancer, och nu hindrar skulderna från tiden innan och under sjukdomen honom från att bygga det liv han vill ha.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Sverre och experterna blir chockade då ett brev dyker upp om att Sverres hus måste säljas. Sverre har valt festandet före att bygga klart sitt hus, och har använt fakturor för att tända brasor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Daniel dricker 3 liter läsk om dagen och gamla lån har hindrat honom och Mona från att bilda familj. Mona tror att Daniel spenderat små summor på vadslagning men det visar sig handla om mer pengar.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2506
programme.desc: Ulrik har tagit stora lån för att etablera sig med familjen men har tappat kontrollen och får en otrevlig överraskning när experterna anländer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Madeleine älskar inredning och hennes garderob är full av nyinköpta kläder. När Madeleine vill ha något nytt så köper hon det. Hon lever över sina tillgångar och de dyra lånen hopar sig.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Robin slösar bort alla sina pengar på dyra hobbies. Han har precis gjort slut med Madeleine från förra avsnittet, och med hennes skyhöga skulder och överdrivna utgifter är hans nya liv svårt.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Bibbi är sjuksköterska och ska snart gå i pension, men med sina skulder kommer hon inte att kunna gå i pension vid 67 års ålder. Hennes hus är fullt av kläder, smycken och tomma champagneflaskor. Kommer hon att kunna ändra sin livsstil?

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: En passionerad helg får Alexis att acceptera Seans impulsiva frieri. Sammy Jo ger efter för Josh Harris passionerade närmanden.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake ber Steven att köra Denver-Carrington. Leslie lyckas förföra Jeff. Sammy Jo kämpar med sin kvardröjande kärlek till Steven och sin passion för Josh, när Josh uppslukas av sitt kokainberoende.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis försöker hindra Dana från att lagligt adoptera Adams surrogatbarn. Adam informerar anonymt pressen om drogproblem i Stevens fotbollslag.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sean hotar Dana med utpressning om hon inte hjälper honom att samla in komprometterande information mot familjen Carrington. Josh Harris är förkrossad över Sammy Jos avslag på hans bröllopsansökan.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter att ha träffat Cora Van Husen får Krystle en kopia av den skandalösa videon som bevisar Blakes oskuld.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter Josh Harris död inser Sammy Jo att hon måste släppa Steven. Fallon är upprörd över Stevens kompromisslösa maktutövning och fjärmar sig alltmer från sin bror.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sean utnyttjar Alexis kandidatur till guvernörsposten för att få kontroll över Colbyco. Sammy Jo och Jeff utvecklar en djup vänskap utifrån sin ömsesidiga ensamhet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle upptäcker skadlig information om Alexis äktenskap med Cecil Colby. Leslie följer Sean till hans fars grav och får reda på hans sanna identitet som Joseph Aynders son.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Tvingad av Adam och Fallons röst går Steven motvilligt med på att godkänna Vitron-oljeaffären, samtidigt som Seans vansinniga plan att hämnas sin fars död börjar utvecklas.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Uppmuntrad av sitt folkliga stöd efter skjutningen bestämmer sig Alexis för att stanna kvar i tävlingen. Sean påskyndar sin plan att använda Vitron-oljeaffären för att krossa Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sean är trött på Leslies hot om att avslöja sin sanna identitet och planterar en giftig orm i hennes rum som en varning för vem hon har att göra med.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Karen skyndas till sjukhuset när hon börjar föda. Efter att Sean hotar Leslie anförtror hon Dex Seans sanna identitet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis varnar Blake för Seans sanna identitet. Blake och Dex, som är oroliga för sin familjs säkerhet, åker till Natumbre för att avslöja Seans mystiska plan med Vitron-oljeaffären.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter explosionen i Natumbre anklagas Blake för att handla med illegala vapen. Alexis avslöjar bevis för att Sean betalade Jesse för att återvända till Denver så att han kunde övertala Karen att behålla Adams barn.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dana försöker desperat övertyga Adam om hur mycket hon vill ha deras son. Hon föreslår att om de var ett kärleksfullt par igen skulle domaren döma till deras fördel.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Adam befrias från misstankar om kidnappningen av sin son när Leslie ringer honom och berättar att Sean har tagit barnet och håller henne fången.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter Seans död tröstas Alexis av Dex, och de två förnyar sin passionerade kärlek till varandra.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Eleanor Williams claimed she was trafficked and beaten by a grooming gang. Her Facebook post went viral and sparked protests across the UK. But the truth behind her allegations shocked everyone. A case that changed several lives forever.
programme.sub-title: Her EVIL Lies Ruined COUNTLESS Lives: The Horrific Crimes of Eleanor Williams

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In December 2019, 30-year-old Nadine Lott was brutally beaten by her ex-partner Daniel Murtagh in her Arklow, Ireland apartment. A neighbor witnessed him attacking her "like a wild animal," growling with rage. She died days later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe went on a Tinder date and never came home. The investigation uncovered a calculated murder planned by two predators. A solved true crime case that will stay with you.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was stalked and murdered by her obsessive ex-boyfriend after the system failed to protect her. Her family now fights to make sure it doesn't happen again. A solved true crime case everyone needs to hear.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Horrific Murder of Alice Ruggles

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In October 1983, 15-year-old Tony Muncy's dismembered remains were found in garbage bags along a rural Ohio road. The case went cold for decades until DNA genealogy identified killer Daniel Anderson in 2020.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Case of Dr. Gulam Moonda // MURDER FOR HIRE PLOT

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Coast Guard mother's baby is found dead in her crib in Alaska. What looked like SIDS turned into a criminal case built on a coerced confession, so the conviction fell apart in court. A true crime case full of unanswered questions.
programme.sub-title: US Coast Guard Confessed to Smothering her Baby, but the Case Fell Apart

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: She sent voice notes to friends saying she feared the worst. Weeks later, a gunman broke into her home looking for her boyfriend and opened fire. A solved true crime case that is devastating, gang-fuelled, and a stark warning about deadly loyalty.
programme.sub-title: She PREDICTED Her Own Murder: The TERRIFYING Killing of Ashley Dale that Lead to MULTIPLE Arrests

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A pastor's pregnant wife is shot during a home invasion while he's at the gym. Police cleared him fast, but the public wasn't convinced. A solved true crime case full of suspicion, conspiracy theories, and heartbreak.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED? The Tragic Murder of Amanda Blackburn // WAS IT REALLY HER HUSBAND?!

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: Illinois serial killer Bruce Lindahl accidentally severed his own femoral artery while stabbing a victim in 1981, dying on the spot. Decades later, DNA forensics posthumously linked him to over 12 murders.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1994, 6-year-old Rikki Neave was strangled by 13-year-old James Watson in Peterborough, England. His mother was wrongly accused. DNA evidence eventually solved the case in 2022, nearly 30 years later.
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Almost Got Away

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A man meets a woman on Facebook who says she needs help. Hours later, his throat is slashed and he's thrown off a bridge into a river. Against all odds, he survived. A solved true crime case that is savage, predatory, and an incredible story of survival.
programme.sub-title: She used Facebook to Lure him in... Then she Slit his Throat & Threw him off a Bridge

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A woman stalks and kills her estranged husband's new girlfriend in broad daylight while witnesses watch. She tried to cover it up, but the evidence was overwhelming. A solved true crime case that is vicious, obsessive, and heartbreakingly avoidable.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Jealous Wife Kills Her Husband's New GF: The Tragic Case of Michelle Boat & Tracy Mondabough

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Belize police superintendent is found dead in the water, shot with his own gun. The only witness? A Canadian socialite with ties to one of the country's most powerful families. Her story didn't add up.
programme.sub-title: MURDER OR ACCIDENT? The Devastating Case of Henry Jemmott and Jasmine Hartin

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 16-year-old calls 911 claiming an intruder killed her mom and her mom's boyfriend. But bloody footprints and security footage told a very different story. A true crime case built on lies that unraveled fast.
programme.sub-title: Teen Thought Dramatic 911 Call Could Fool Cops... But She Forgot One Thing

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 2016, 27-year-old Jessie Bardwell was murdered by her boyfriend Jason Lowe in Texas. He stored her body in his car for days while sexting other women. He was convicted and sentenced to 50 years in prison.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Florida’s Oldest Missing Child Case That Still Has No Answers: The Puzzling Case of "Jon Jon" Hagans
programme.desc: On June 11, 1968 Jonathan "Jon Jon" Hagans vanished from Jacksonville Beach during a day out in the sun with his loved ones. Authorities wanted to say the waves swept him away but his family never agreed with that theory.
programme.sub-title: Florida’s Oldest Missing Child Case That Still Has No Answers: The Puzzling Case of "Jon Jon" Hagans

programme.title: Gabulosis: Genetic Genealogy Cracks 53 Year Old Mystery in 2025

programme.sub-title: Genetic Genealogy Cracks 53 Year Old Mystery in 2025

programme.title: Gabulosis: Woman Found in Miami Parking Lot is Still Nameless 45 Years Later
programme.desc: On the morning of September 4, 1979 the lifeless body of an unidentified woman was found near the dumpsters behind a Miami apartment complex. Her identity and who took her life is still unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: Woman Found in Miami Parking Lot is Still Nameless 45 Years Later

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?
